description: Prepare a token launch for the person to sign on marketmayhem.co. Needs a name, a ticker, an opening market cap and a logo link. Optional first buy in the same transaction (so nobody buys before them), split across up to 8 wallets; the dead address 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD burns that part. burnPct sends the creator royalty to buy back and burn. Nothing launches until they confirm.

burnPct.description: share of the creator royalty that buys back and burns, for ever (100 = all)

firstBuy.description: a first buy in the pair currency, inside the launch

image.description: an https:// link to the logo (PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP, up to 5 MB). Required: ask the person for one

marketCapUsd.description: the opening market cap in dollars

pair.description: "BNB" (default), a listed symbol like "USDT", or any BEP20 address

royaltyTo.description: send the royalty to another wallet (only with burnPct 0)

shape.description: how the supply is laid out: "flat" (default), "stepped", "steep", or 1 to 4 custom ranges { fromPct, toPct, bps } measured from the top of the platform curve, bps adding to 10000

wallet.description: the person's wallet, if they told you; the sign page checks it is the one that signs

name: prepare_launch
